glossary.data_protection_framework: jurisdictional regulatory requirements governing data handling (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, PIPEDA), including transfer mechanisms and representative appointment rules.
glossary.gap-assessment: systematic evaluation of current program state against target jurisdiction’s framework to identify compliance gaps; discovery tasks replace assumptions where current state is unknown.
glossary.vendor_due_diligence: structured questionnaires assessing third-party compliance with data protection obligations, aligned with jurisdiction-specific requirements.
glossary.critical_path: sequence of dependencies where delays propagate through the project timeline, requiring explicit hard/soft distinction for sequencing.
glossary.early-warning_indicator: threshold-based trigger for escalation or mitigation action in risk register entries.

entry_criteria: All 3 target jurisdictions’ data protection frameworks documented via supplied inputs (jurisdictions, existing program assets).
Shared engineering capacity confirmed with platform migration constraints.
Two approved analyst requisitions allocated to support discovery tasks.

workstreams.name: Jurisdiction-Specific Framework Documentation

artifacts.output: Structured JSON maps of framework elements (e.g., transfer mechanisms, representative appointment rules)

workstreams.coverage: All 3 jurisdictions’ frameworks mapped to existing program assets (records inventory, incident runbook, consent manager, vendor questionnaires).

workstreams.name: Current State Discovery

artifacts.output: JSON gap matrix: asset → compliance status (pass/fail/unknown)

workstreams.coverage: Current state of records inventory and incident runbook; discovery tasks where current state is unknown.

workstreams.name: Vendor Due Diligence Questionnaire Alignment
workstreams.coverage: Alignment of vendor questionnaires with jurisdiction-specific requirements.

exit_criteria: All 3 jurisdictions’ frameworks documented in structured format.
Gap matrices for records inventory and incident runbook completed; discovery tasks logged for unknown states.
Vendor questionnaires aligned to jurisdiction-specific templates.

entry_criteria: All workstreams with incomplete outputs identified via gap matrices.

workstreams.name: Compensating Control Design

artifacts.document: Workstream-specific compensating controls (e.g., additional monitoring, audit trails)

workstreams.coverage: Controls for workstreams blocked by launch deadline.

artifacts.document: Mitigation plans with early-warning indicators for compensating controls.

exit_criteria: Compensating controls documented for all incomplete workstreams.
Mitigation plans with early-warning indicators approved.

entry_criteria: All compensating controls and mitigation plans approved.
Vendor questionnaires aligned to jurisdiction-specific templates.

artifacts.document: Launch readiness checklist with compensating controls status.

slip_threshold.recompute_criteria: Any hard-dependency delay exceeding 7 days triggers recomputation.

entries.description: Platform migration constraints delay discovery tasks.
mitigation: Coordinate with engineering to prioritize discovery tasks during platform downtime.
Document compensating controls for delayed workstreams.

early_warning_indicator.threshold: Engineering confirms >50% of discovery tasks blocked by migration constraints.
early_warning_indicator.action: Escalate to Program Manager; recompute critical path.

entries.description: Vendor questionnaires not aligned to jurisdiction-specific requirements.
mitigation: Revisit questionnaire templates with compliance team; audit samples per jurisdiction.

early_warning_indicator.threshold: First three questionnaires fail alignment review.
early_warning_indicator.action: Escalate to Compliance Review Board; halt vendor due diligence.

entries.description: Unknown current state in records inventory or incident runbook.
mitigation: Log discovery tasks; assign analysts to resolve unknown states within 10 days.

early_warning_indicator.action: Escalate to Compliance Review Board; document compensating controls.

information_needed: Alignment of vendor questionnaires with jurisdiction-specific requirements.
Compensating controls for delayed discovery tasks.
open_decisions.timeframe: Within 7 days of early-warning indicator trigger.

escalation_path.decision: Approval/Rejection of compensating controls or questionnaire templates.
escalation_path.blocker: Decision blocks Phase 2 launch readiness review.

information_needed: Platform migration constraints and discovery task prioritization.
Critical path recomputation if delays exceed thresholds.
open_decisions.timeframe: Within 3 days of critical path slip detection.

notes: Assumptions: All jurisdictions’ frameworks are distinct but align with existing program assets. Discovery tasks are skipped only if current state is confirmed as compliant (no gaps).
Derived dates: Phase start/end derived from 90-day spaced launch milestones.
